parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number for a paged query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 500. Valid values: any integer from 1 to 500.

parameters.name: SiteInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the associated site plan.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The sort field. By default, results are sorted by purchase time. Valid values:

- **CreateTime**: purchase time.

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

- asc: ascending order.
- desc: descending order.
